[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Naren Bluuis''' was the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] fleet coordinator for the [[Corva sector/Legends|Corva sector]]. He was assisted in his duties by a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] called [[Kiara Schmong]].
